en_title: GTA 6 is Now The Joint-Highest Rated Game of All Time
cn_title: 《GTA6》现已并列成为有史以来评分最高的游戏
opus_summary: 随着大量评测发布，《GTA6》在Metacritic获得99分，与N64版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》并列史上最高。截稿时，《GTA6》已有超过120篇评测，其中超过100篇给出满分；IGN也为其打出10分。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 has become the joint-highest rated game of all time, following the widespread publication of reviews in the past hour.
paragraphs.cn: 随着过去一小时内大量评测发布，《GTA6》已并列成为有史以来评分最高的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar's masterpiece currently sits with an all-time best score of 99 on Metacritic , an honor shared only with Nintendo's original The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time release back in 1997 on N64, almost 30 years ago. No other game since has managed such a feat. (The new version of Ocarina for Switch 2 managed a paltry score of just 96.)
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的杰作目前在Metacritic上的评分为99分，创下历史最高纪录，只有任天堂近30年前于1997年在N64上推出的原版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》与其共享这一荣誉。此后没有其他游戏取得过这样的成绩。（Switch 2上的新版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》只拿到了区区96分。）

paragraphs.en: While both the N64 version of Ocarina and GTA 6 share a 99 average, GTA 6 has impressively managed to pull this off with more than six times' the number of reviews — over 120 at the time of writing, with over 100 of those listed with a perfect score. And while it's possible GTA 6's ranking could still slip down a point as more reviews are published, it would still be the best-rated game in nearly three decades.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管N64版《塞尔达传说 时之笛》和《GTA6》的平均分同为99分，但令人印象深刻的是，《GTA6》是在评测数量超过前者六倍的情况下取得这一成绩的——截至撰稿时已有超过120篇评测，其中超过100篇给出了满分。随着更多评测发布，《GTA6》的评分仍有可能下降一分，但即便如此，它仍将是近30年来评分最高的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Few others titles released in the recent memory have come anywhere close to this — though if you head back to the last console generation, Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild and Super Mario Odyssey both managed a 97 average, a standing they share with Rockstar's own Red Dead Redemption 2.
paragraphs.cn: 近些年发售的其他游戏中，鲜有作品的评分能接近这一成绩——不过，如果回顾上一代主机，任天堂的《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》和《超级马力欧 奥德赛》都取得了97分的平均分，Rockstar自家的《荒野大镖客：救赎2》也获得了同样的分数。

paragraphs.en: IGN's GTA 6 review is of course now live, and also returned a perfect 10/10 score. We described it as "exquisitely detailed, endlessly ripe for experimentation, and uncompromisingly engineered," as well as "unprecedented, unbelievable and unmissable."
paragraphs.cn: IGN的《GTA6》评测当然也已上线，同样给出了10/10的满分。我们称其「细节精美、提供无穷无尽的实验空间、制作精益求精」，并称其「前所未有、令人难以置信、不容错过」。

paragraphs.en: IGN has everything you need for the launch of GTA 6, including the GTA 6 global release times , as well as details on the last-minute PS5 update you'll need to download . In case you missed it, last night we learned the real-life identity of GTA 6's Lucia . And we're now live with our GTA 6 launch blog , which we'll use to fill you in on everything else about the game over the coming hours.
paragraphs.cn: IGN提供了《GTA6》发售所需的一切信息，包括《GTA6》的全球发售时间，以及你需要下载的最后一刻PS5更新的详情。如果你错过了，昨晚我们还得知了《GTA6》中Lucia的现实身份。我们的《GTA6》发售博客现已上线，接下来的几个小时里，我们将在那里为你介绍有关这款游戏的其他一切。
